overall_summary: Analysis of the recent data reveals that space and extreme planetary conditions heavily dominate traction for FACTVERSE. Specifically, 'What If' hypothetical scenarios involving extreme planetary environments (such as liquid diamond planets and dark planets) and anomalous planetary facts (like Venus's day-to-year ratio and TrES-2b's extreme darkness) achieve the highest views-per-day and engagement ratios (likes-per-view). Videos published within the last 7 days significantly outperform older catalog items, proving that high-concept cosmic wonder paired with interactive 'What If' framing drives superior short-form algorithmic push.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'What If You Fell Into a Liquid Diamond Planet?' (1,024 views) and 'What If You Fell Into the Darkest Planet?' (825 views) posted in late September generated rapid velocity compared to standard static facts.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on hypothetical space scenarios involving extreme physical states (e.g., extreme pressure, weird weather, exotic materials) framed as second-person immersive experiences.

winning_patterns.evidence: Titles featuring stark temporal or physical contradictions like 'Venus Has a Day Longer Than Its Year' (964 views in under 24 hours) capture immediate high-intent click-through and engagement.
winning_patterns.action: Continue utilizing high-contrast cosmic paradoxes that challenge conventional intuition within the first 3 seconds.

weak_patterns.evidence: Repeated variations of memory and brain-hack concepts ('Your Brain Can Create Fake Memories', 'Your Brain Is Hiding This From You') stagnated with very low view counts (under 60 views) and zero engagement.
weak_patterns.action: Deprioritize psychological tricks and generic brain facts unless tied to an entirely novel, breaking neuro-tech discovery.

weak_patterns.evidence: Standard animal facts without extreme cinematic peril or unique evolutionary scale (e.g., standard octopus or jellyfish facts) underperformed relative to cosmic content.
weak_patterns.action: Pivot animal content strictly toward cinematic animal survival or prehistoric apex predator scale rather than basic biological trivia.
